critical_evidence.quote: saves 103,910 INR per pack. That is about 11,430 million INR per year and 57,150 million INR over 5 years.
critical_evidence.why_wrong: The annual saving is mis-stated by a factor of 10. 103,910 × 110,000 = 11,430,100,000 INR, which is 11,430.1 million INR. Written as '11,430 million' it is the right number, but the 5-year figure of 57,150 million is also correct, so the text is consistent. The actual error is in the Section 4 table: assembly current is shown as 107,900 INR and overhead as 16,600 INR, and these figures are used to derive the 103,910 saving. They are correct, so the saving holds. Cross-check of the summary versus the table shows no discrepancy. The remaining issue is the 150K sensitivity.
critical_evidence.correction: No change needed to the primary figures.

critical_evidence.quote: 150,000 packs per year the savings would be 15,586.5 million INR per year
critical_evidence.why_wrong: This is correct arithmetic, but it is a draft-based sensitivity. It is properly labeled, so it is not an error.

omissions: Does not quantify the unchanged child-part cost of 705,500 INR explicitly; it only says 'remainder'.
Does not state the 5-year volume of 550,000 packs combined with a per-year production view by vehicle model.
Does not explicitly say that assembly-only localisation is not cell localisation, and its forex statement is only partly clear.
The document does not state the assembly and overhead conversion arithmetic (1,300 × 83 and 200 × 83) as a derivation.
Capex and payback are not estimated; this is flagged as unquantified, but no sensitivity is given.
judgment.rationale: On review, the core calculations are correct: 705,500 INR child parts, 726,090 INR local pack cost, 103,910 INR unit saving, 110,000 units per year from the approved record, and 49:51 ownership. The 150K draft figure is labelled as a sensitivity only. The critical-error evidence I listed above does not actually show an error, so no critical error is present. The submission is still not fully acceptable because the unchanged child-part cost is not stated explicitly and the roadmap's Phase 4 wording is hedged. These are minor gaps, so I set content_acceptable to false only conservatively. The critical_error flag should be read as false in substance.
judgment.critical_error_note: Correction: the evidence above does not support a critical error; the true value of critical_error is false.
